Author: LolipopJ
Name: MomoTalk
Description: Bring Blue Archive's iconic MomoTalk into FINAL FANTASY XIV! Crafted for every Sensei in Eorzea, MomoTalk turns your in-game friend /tells into a faithful Blue Archive messenger — complete with a draggable floating phone button, the signature bouncy opening splash, grouped chat bubbles, Lodestone avatars, editable friend notes, and per-character local history. Open with /momotalk or tap the floating MomoTalk icon anytime.
Punchline: Blue Archive's MomoTalk in Eorzea — [Hayase Yuuka] Sensei! I need you to work harder!
